verdict.rationale: Audit logging of flag changes is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a change history or audit log recording who changed a gate, when, and to what value. The feature-gate exposures view covers which users encounter a gate, not changes to it, and the SSO/SCIM material covers access management rather than change auditing.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value
